out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed hot water at hand sink at 95F during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. A follow up will be conducted within 10 days to assess for presence of hot water.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed hot water at 3 compartment sink at 86-91F during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS will conduct a follow up inspection within 10 days to assess compliance.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The permit holder has installed or replaced a warewashing machine. The current water heater (Lochinvar, KTA052KD 130, 4.5 kW) does not have the capacity to meet an increase in hourly hot water demands required by the addition of the warewashing machine. Observed insufficient hot water in facility. Current water heater is not sufficient to meet peak hourly demands based on hot water calculation.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 45 gph at a 80F rise, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. Person in charge contacted maintenance during inspection. A follow up will be conducted within 10 days to assess presence of hot water in facility.
